violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Ice machine is soiled in the interior ceiling
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM clean and sanitized ice machine. A picture was sent to EHS email.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: Observed missing thermometers in unit # 1, 2, 5
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM installed new thermometers to units # 1,2,5

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed scoops in the heater dipper well at 110F and timer off.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM washed, rinsed, sanitized scoops and set up dipper well to 4 hours

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): 2 door flat top cooler right door needs a new gasket.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. CFM will replace the gasket. Compliance with this violation will be reviewed during the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed mop store in standing water in the mop bucket
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CFM washed the mop and stored it upside down. An air- drying rack needs to be installed so mops can be hung properly to air dry and to prevent the mop handles from becoming contaminated.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed ice cream scoops in dip well at 105F
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM washed, rinsed and sanitized scoops and store them in 135F at a 4 hr timer
